review_findings_fixed: CRITICAL fixed: HNSW iid gap after a rebuild (newest rows deleted before a requantize left next_iid above len+1, the next insert opened a gap the encoder refuses, every flush failed and maintain() poisoned the shard, op tail grew unbounded). rebuild_from_vectors renumbers densely whenever max_iid != len OR next_iid != len+1 (identity pairs persist NEXT_IID); maintain() heals a deterministic encoder refusal by a dense rebuild + rebase instead of poisoning. Regression: the review's exact repro (64+64+10 l2 HNSW dim 8, delete 129..138, requantize, upsert 5) flushes directly and reloads Current; a forced gap (stale meta.next_iid) heals.

HIGH fixed: no HNSW graph build on the request path. ensure_index rebuilds flat (quantize only) on a request, but marks HNSW rebuild_pending and answers 503 shard_unavailable without poisoning; the alarm (maintenance_due Now) rebuilds. Rebase flushes write two epochs with the same payload/seq, so one corrupt chunk falls back to Previous with bit-identical results and the rebuild path needs both copies bad. HNSW admission also caps nodes by REBUILD_BUDGET_MS 20 s (fits the 30 s default; limits.cpu_ms is refused on this account's plan). Partial correction: the requantize-alarm rebuild is bounded (needs_requantize only fires while the trained sample is < 1000 rows, so that rebuild is ≤ ~2k rows, never cap-sized).

HIGH fixed: HNSW link repair runs in alarm slices (resident cursor, repair_slice_nodes ≈ 2 s of modelled wasm CPU per slice, re-armed while in progress, writes interleave); the final slice purges, renumbers, shrinks and writes a rebase.
